title: "Ideas / feature wishlist"
body: |
  Thanks for sharing an idea for Freetz-EVO!

  Before posting, please check the
  [documentation](https://ircama.github.io/freetz-evo/) and the existing
  discussions to make sure the idea has not already been suggested.

  Please describe:

  ## Summary
  What feature or package would you like to see?

  ## Use case
  What problem does it solve, and for whom?

  ## Proposed implementation
  - Upstream project / package (with link), if any
  - Required libraries / dependencies (e.g. jemalloc, libxml2 ...)
  - Target devices / firmware series
  - Any relevant AVM constraints

  ## Alternatives
  Any alternative approaches you considered.

  Ideas that receive community interest are typically implemented as new
  packages in the [freetz-evo repository](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo)
  — pull requests are always welcome!
labels: [idea, enhancement]
